mvp_description: Transit routing and delivery optimization platform

top_buyers.name: Ashtabula County Transportation System (ACTS)
top_buyers.fit_rationale: Operates point deviation and door-to-door transit services. Route optimization tools would improve service efficiency and reduce travel times. County-operated public transit.

top_buyers.name: NOACA (Northeast Ohio Areawide Coordinating Agency)
top_buyers.fit_rationale: Coordinates transit planning across Northeast Ohio. Route optimization and transit planning tools would support regional mobility initiatives. Regional planning authority.

additional_contacts.name: Unis Logistics (Ashtabula)
additional_contacts.fit_rationale: Specializes in less-than-truckload shipping and freight consolidation. Route optimization would improve delivery efficiency.

additional_contacts.name: RTA (Greater Cleveland Regional Transit Authority)
additional_contacts.fit_rationale: Major transit provider serving Cleveland and surrounding areas. Route planning tools could enhance service planning.

additional_contacts.name: Ashtabula County Trucking Companies
additional_contacts.fit_rationale: Multiple local trucking and logistics companies. Route optimization platform would benefit small carriers.

research_notes: Emails inferred for ACTS and NOACA. Strong transportation infrastructure in Northeast Ohio. Multiple transit and logistics providers in the region.
